title: WireDocUpdate
description:
Per-batch operations emitted by a Deno connector.

MVP carries only `Upsert` and `Delete`. **Patch is intentionally
omitted** — full Upsert covers every expressible state change; Patch
is a wire-payload optimization that will be added when a real
connector hits the pain point (e.g. 50 KB content with cursor-only
updates), at which point we'll also resolve the
null-vs-absent-vs-delete-field semantics.

Tag layout is `{ "kind": "upsert", "doc": { ... } }` /
`{ "kind": "delete", "id": "..." }`. The explicit
`rename_all = "snake_case"` is required: serde's default variant
naming would emit `Upsert` / `Delete`.

WireDoc.description:
A document delivered from a Deno connector to the Gety host.

Mirrors core `Doc`'s author-facing fields. Host-internal fields
(DocInternalId, parsed `DateTime<Local>`) never appear on the wire.

Defaults applied by the host when the field is absent on the wire:
`doc_updated_at` → ingestion time fallback; `doc_type` → `"other"`;
`original_file_size` → `None`; `content_format` → `Plaintext`.
Authors should fill `doc_updated_at` with a stable source-of-truth
timestamp (Notion `last_edited_time`, GitHub `updated_at`, …) so
recency tags and time facets do not drift on every re-upsert.
Recognized metadata keys:
- `url` is the conventional field for manifest `doc_link.field = "url"`.
- `created_at` may hold an RFC 3339 source creation timestamp for preview
  display; the host validates it when present.

doc_type.description:
Recommended `<namespace>:<type>` (e.g. `notion:page`, `file:pdf`,
`fs:folder`). Rust host does **not** validate the format; UI
facet logic only recognizes the `file:*` prefix in MVP.

doc_updated_at.description:
RFC 3339 string (a strict ISO-8601 profile; include an offset or `Z`).
Host converts to `DateTime<Local>` during `into_core_doc()`; missing →
ingestion time; unparseable → poll error.
